text: APIs connect the virtual mailbox to other business tools so documents and mail stay in sync
quote: Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.

text: Multiple people can be given access to one virtual mailbox for shared visibility and collaboration
quote: Give multiple people access to your virtual mailbox for easier collaboration and shared visibility across your mail.

text: Checks received in the mail are sent directly to your bank of deposit to be deposited into your account
quote: Deposit checks into your bank account by having the checks mailed directly to your bank of deposit. A reliable, easier way to manage payments remotely.

text: Check deposit costs $20 per check, with free overnight shipping for Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo accounts
quote: $20 per check; complimentary overnight shipping is provided for checks deposited into accounts with Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo.

text: AI-generated summaries and automatic labels organize incoming mail
quote: Get instant AI summaries and automatic labels that help you stay on top of your mail, save time, and keep your inbox organized.

text: Choose from 53 real street addresses across 44 states, including Park Avenue NYC and Market Street SF
quote: Choose from 53 real street addresses across 44 states, including prime locations like Park Avenue in New York and Market Street in San Francisco.

text: Junk mail filtering keeps the mailbox uncluttered and helps you stay under plan limits
quote: Filter out junk mail to keep your inbox organized and clutter-free, so you can focus on the mail that matters—while staying under your limits.

text: Use the virtual business address on public records to keep your personal address private
quote: Protect your privacy by listing a virtual business address on public records instead of exposing your own to the public.

text: View mail online from anywhere as high-resolution scans
quote: View your mail from anywhere with junk filtering, high-resolution scans, and AI summaries and categorization that help you save time and stay organized.

text: Mail is received and securely stored, with digital copies in the cloud and physical items forwardable anywhere
quote: Receive and securely store your mail. Access digital copies safely in the cloud, or easily forward physical items wherever you need them.

text: Forwarding fees are published: international $5 per shipment plus postage, expedited $10 per shipment plus postage
quote: International $5 per shipment plus postage ... Expedited shipment $10 per shipment plus postage

text: Mail data is protected with 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication
quote: Keep your business mail secure with multi-layered protection, including 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication.

text: Mail is opened and scanned in company-operated facilities with access controls
quote: Keep sensitive mail handling in trusted hands with opening and scanning completed in facilities we operate with access controls.

text: Complimentary onboarding session with a dedicated team of virtual mail specialists
quote: Complimentary onboarding session by a dedicated team of virtual mail specialists

text: Works with LegalZoom business formation services, including complimentary Secretary of State status reports
quote: Virtual Mail also works with your LegalZoom business formation services, including complimentary Secretary of State Status reports and other entitled services.

text: Unlimited cloud storage for digitized mail; physical letters held up to 30 days and packages up to 10 days
quote: Unlimited cloud storage applies to digitized mail. Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages

text: Scanning is free up to the plan limit, and secure shredding is included
quote: Scanning is free up to your plan limit, and secure shredding is included.
